sources.entry: Rekody - Voice dictation CLI for macOS: hold a hotkey, speak, and on-device transcription types the text at the cursor in any app.

summary.one_liner: rekody is an open-source, macOS-only terminal voice dictation tool: hold ⌥Space, speak, release, and the transcribed text is typed at the cursor in any app.
summary.what_it_does: Runs as a CLI on macOS that captures microphone audio while you hold (or toggle) ⌥Space and inserts the transcript at the cursor via clipboard paste or native key events. It offers several speech-to-text engines: a streaming on-device Nemotron engine (English, Apple Silicon), local whisper.cpp with Core ML, and cloud options Deepgram, Groq, and Cohere. An optional LLM cleanup step can run through many providers (including Apple on-device Foundation Models, Ollama, and various cloud APIs) with automatic failover, and "skills" reshape output into forms like email or commit messages. It also includes a custom vocabulary dictionary, searchable dictation history, a "fix" command to correct labels for saved audio, and API keys stored in the macOS Keychain.
use_cases: voice dictation into any macOS app
dictating emails or commit messages with LLM cleanup
building a personal voice fine-tuning dataset
how_to_run: git clone <repo URL> && cd rekody && make install
notable: Streaming transcription with the on-device Nemotron engine, showing words about 160ms behind speech
Skills: Markdown prompt files that reshape dictation via the LLM, switchable mid-dictation with ⌥Space+Tab
API keys kept in the macOS Keychain; no telemetry
Fine-tuning dataset: saves lossless FLAC audio plus transcript locally on opt-in
Apple Foundation Models on-device cleanup on macOS 26+ with no key needed
caveats: macOS only (Apple Silicon or Intel) and requires Accessibility and Microphone permissions
Nemotron streaming engine is English only and Apple Silicon only
Skills and AI cleanup do nothing unless an LLM provider is configured; cleanup is disabled automatically with Deepgram
Desktop HUD is in private preview and distributed separately
